subdomain.name: Telemetry Ingestion & Processing
subdomain.capability: Continuous high-throughput ingestion of 1Hz sensor telemetry, metric boundary validation, out-of-order reconciliation, append-only storage and backpressure-aware broadcasting.
subdomain.why_distinct: Own rules, lifecycle and language (device vs ingress time, backfill window, immutability) distinct from downstream athletic analytics.

ubiquitous_language.definition: Individual 1Hz data point (heart rate, power, cadence, ground contact time, respiration, swim stroke).
Raw transmission from an edge device, bike computer or wearable carrying samples.
Physical physiological/mechanical limit a metric must respect.
Demand-driven flow control for burst loads without blocking I/O.
t_device: epoch generated by the device; ordering basis.
t_ingress: arrival time at the service; not used for ordering.
60-second window in which late packets are re-indexed chronologically.
Appended record representing a correction or backfill of earlier data.

bounded_contexts.name: Telemetry Ingestion & Validation
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Accept ingress packets non-blockingly and tag samples against sensor metric boundaries.
in_scope: Boundary validation (HR 30-240, Power 0-2500W, Cadence 0-220, swim pace >45 s/100m)
invariants: Every sample is validated against its Sensor Metric Boundary before downstream propagation
Invalid samples are flagged VALIDATION_FAILED and never dropped
Ingestion entry point performs no blocking I/O and applies backpressure

bounded_contexts.name: Telemetry Stream Reconciliation
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Re-index late samples by device timestamp within the reorder window and buffer windowed streams for analytics and broadcast.
invariants: Ordering is by t_device, never t_ingress
Packets delayed up to 60 seconds are reordered chronologically
source_of_truth: Chronological order of samples within the window

bounded_contexts.name: Telemetry Event Store
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Persist raw telemetry append-only with revisions for corrections and backfills.
invariants: Raw records are strictly append-only; corrections append new revisions

assumptions.item: Description names a single domain; split into three contexts by rule ownership (validation, ordering, immutability).
assumptions.impact_on_boundaries: Could merge into one context if team prefers.

assumptions.item: Storage technology and downstream event stream consumers unspecified.
Treatment of packets later than 60 seconds is unspecified (assumed appended as revisions).
assumptions.impact_on_boundaries: Affects ownership between reconciliation and event store.
